raw_html: [[Alchemical_Crafting#Legendary|Legendary Alchemical Crafting (Prototype)]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Alchemical_Crafting#Legendary|Legendary Alchemical Crafting (Prototype)]]:''' This experimental item, crafted and enchanted at ancient Cannith creation forges using powerful alchemy, is made of a material that allows elemental power sources to be bound to it.
